arguments.premise_synthesis: Companies raised prices when tariffs were imposed, passing the cost to consumers. Now that tariffs are being refunded due to a Supreme Court ruling, companies are not expected to lower prices, meaning they keep both the price increases and the refunds, effectively profiting from the tariff policy at public expense.
